name: @scmmishra/chatwoot-pr-review
description: Pull requests that wait for your review, with their diff, CI and unresolved comments in Comet

settings.title: Hide approved PRs
settings.description: Hides pull requests that already have an approving review.

settings.title: Only PRs into the base branch
settings.description: Hides pull requests that merge into another branch, such as stacked ones.

settings.title: Base branch
settings.description: The branch the filter above keeps. Empty uses the repository's default branch.

settings.title: Guide agent
settings.description: The agent that writes a pull request's review guide.

settings.title: Guide model
settings.description: The guide agent's model, such as sonnet. Empty uses the agent's default model.
